misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen, timestamped forecast specification linked to its eligible evidence cutoff and realized outcome could make forecast assessment possible. The supplied material does not show that this record would have changed a decision or prevented a demonstrated miss.
misses.decision_relevance: The registry states that forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs are missing. Without them, target-time settlement prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or demonstrate a decision failure.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: Settlement records provide confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but the supplied evidence does not link them to a prior forecast specification, decision timestamp, or eligible evidence cutoff. Therefore no forecast or decision miss is supported.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. The settlement capture times are explicitly adjudication target times, not source-observation or decision times.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records include EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36, EXP-FC-fda5190d000dbc293f4e, and other listed EXP-FC records. They establish target-time prices only; the registry states that they are not linked to an available prior forecast specification.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
